results.question: 上海的客户一共有多少个？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = '上海'

results.question: 钻石会员（vip_level 为 3）有多少人？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE vip_level = 3

results.question: 售价最高的商品是哪个？给出商品名和售价。
results.gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 2025年1月一共产生了多少笔订单？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-01-31'

results.question: 各个订单状态分别有多少笔订单？
results.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

results.question: 每个商品品类下各有多少个商品？
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

results.question: 手机数码品类里售价最贵的商品是什么？给出名称和售价。
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, p.price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '手机数码' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 下单次数最多的前5名客户是谁？给出客户名和下单次数，次数相同按客户名排序。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.name LIMIT 5

results.question: 北京的客户总共下了多少笔订单？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.city = '北京'

results.question: 每个城市各有多少客户？按客户数从多到少排列。
results.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY cnt DESC

results.question: 所有已完成（completed）订单的成交总金额是多少？成交金额按订单明细的数量乘以成交单价计算。
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

results.question: 按销量（销售数量合计）最高的前5个商品是哪些？给出商品名和销量。
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 每个品类的成交总金额分别是多少？成交金额按明细数量乘以成交单价计算。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id

results.question: 平均每笔订单包含多少件商品（按明细数量合计）？
results.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS cnt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

results.question: 每种支付方式分别有多少笔支付、总金额多少？
results.gold_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM payments GROUP BY method

results.question: 2025年上半年（1月到6月）每个月的支付总金额是多少？按月份排列。
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) AS month, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND paid_at <= '2025-06-30' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

results.question: 金卡及以上（vip_level 大于等于 2）客户的平均单笔支付金额是多少？
results.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.vip_level >= 2

results.question: 注册之后从来没有下过订单的客户有多少个？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

results.question: 支付总金额最高的前3个城市是哪几个？给出城市和金额。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: 按毛利（成交单价减去成本，再乘以数量）计算，毛利最高的品类是哪个？给出品类名和毛利。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1
